title: CaMBRAIN: Real-time, Continuous EEG Inference with Causal State Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.28792v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a critical, non-invasive method to monitor electrical brain activity. EEGs can span anywhere from a couple seconds to multiple hours, posing a major hurdle for existing deep learning methods due to two major factors: (1) existing EEG models are predominantly built upon the attention mechanism, incurring quadratic scaling as the sequence length increases, and (2) raw EEG signals must be processed in a sliding-window fashion due to fixed-length input requirements, preventing global understanding of the entire signal. To this extent, we propose CaMBRAIN - the first Causal, Mamba-based state space model (SSM) capable of real-time inference of EEG signals, arguing that bidirectional approaches are needlessly expensive given the causal, unidirectional nature of EEG. translated_title: CaMBRAIN：基于因果状态空间模型的实时连续脑电（EEG）推理
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）是一种监测大脑电活动的关键无创方法。脑电信号的时长跨度可以从几秒到数小时不等，这对现有深度学习方法构成了重大挑战，主要原因有二：（1）现有脑电模型主要建立在注意力机制之上，随着序列长度增加会产生二次方的计算复杂度；（2）由于固定长度输入的要求，原始脑电信号必须以滑动窗口的方式处理，导致无法对整个信号进行全局理解。为此，我们提出了CaMBRAIN——首个能够对脑电信号进行实时推理的因果（Causal）、基于Mamba的状态空间模型（SSM）。我们认为，鉴于脑电信号固有的因果性、单向性本质，双向建模方法的代价是不必要的。然而，训练这样的模型并非易事，因为关键的脑电事件可能极其短暂——不足一秒——却彼此之间被……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了首个基于Mamba的因果状态空间模型CaMBRAIN，实现了脑电信号的实时连续推理，克服了注意力机制的二次方复杂度和滑动窗口处理无法全局理解信号的局限。
en_tdlr: CaMBRAIN, the first causal Mamba-based state space model, enables real-time continuous EEG inference, overcoming the quadratic scaling of attention mechanisms and the limited global understanding inherent to sliding-window processing.
